interpretation: Second real, non-collapsed TOFU comparison point. NPO at the same matched dose (13 steps/1 epoch, standard lr) shows almost identical movement to GA at the same dose (forget_Q_A_Prob 0.88->0.80 for both methods, model_utility preserved similarly ~0.587-0.599). No collapse. Both GA and NPO on TOFU, at a properly-tuned (non-collapsed) dose, show comparable, real, moderate forgetting -- consistent with the diagnostic study's methodology of comparing methods at matched, non-degenerate operating points rather than uncontrolled defaults.
